messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: { "description": "A stout quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing side view standing on a small patch of bare ground with sparse green tufts. It has a broad, flat, axolotl-like head with a wide mouth and large eyes, a pale wrinkled underbelly and limbs, and a dorsal covering of large overlapping brown-gray scales that extends from the top of the head across the entire back and sides and onto a broad, flat, paddle-shaped tail. Six dark stalk-like external gills with dense reddish feathery filaments protrude from the neck just behind the head, three on each side. The body is low-slung on four short thick legs that end in clawed feet.", "parts": [ { "part": "head", "looks_like": "broad, flat and rounded at the snout with a wide slightly upturned mouth, two small circular nostrils at the tip, and large round eyes with dark pupils and golden-blue irises on the sides", "where": "at the front of the body, facing to the right" }, { "part": "gills", "looks_like": "six dark fleshy stalks tipped and fringed with dense reddish filamentous branches, feathery and comb-like", "where": "protruding outward and upward from the neck region immediately behind the head, three visible on the near side and three on the far side" }, { "part": "scales", "looks_like": "large overlapping rounded keratinous plates in mottled brown and gray with darker edges, arranged in rows like roof tiles", "where": "covering the top of the head, the entire dorsal back and sides, and the top and sides of the tail to its tip" }, { "part": "legs", "looks_like": "four short, thick, muscular limbs with pale wrinkled skin and folded joints, splayed outward", "where": "two under the chest and two under the hips, supporting the body above the ground" }, { "part": "feet", "looks_like": "four broad five-toed feet with slightly webbed digits and dark pointed claws on each toe", "where": "at the ends of the four legs, planted on the ground" }, { "part": "tail", "looks_like": "a single broad, flat, paddle-shaped tail, fully covered in overlapping scales, tapering slightly to a rounded tip", "where": "extending from the rear of the body to the left" } ], "attached_objects": [], "animals": ["axolotl", "pangolin"], "separate_bodies": 1, "heads": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0, "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "tails": 1 }
